title: Register page: password mismatch is a top banner instead of a field error, and there are no 隐私 / 条款 links although the login page shows them
body:
Filing gate **① a reproduced UX defect** (class a, public door: `/_console/register`). `reach:` local stack, objectui pin `6f629a7`, zh-CN, 2026-10-25. Two defects on the sign-up page:
- A mismatched confirmation shows 「两次输入的密码不一致」 as a low-contrast banner at the **top** of the form, not under the confirm field. The user's eyes are on the button at the bottom.
- The page carries **no 隐私 / 条款 links**, while `/_console/login` shows both in its footer.

Unchanged on objectui `main` `be64bf67c`.

Batch-of: 10 · 2026-10-25 desktop E2E (signup · magic flow · invite), filed at the maintainer's request in session: 「必要的合理的建议都可以立卡」.

**Business reason.** Sign-up is where a customer agrees to the terms. Showing them on login, but not where the account is created, is the wrong way round. The `termsUrl` / `privacyUrl` are already published by `/api/v1/auth/config`. A field error that appears far from the field costs a retry on the very first form a customer fills in.

**Reader who acts.** The `repo:objectui` ui seat: `packages/auth/src/RegisterForm.tsx` and the console register page.

## Where
- `packages/auth/src/RegisterForm.tsx:172/221`: the mismatch is set as the top `AuthErrorBanner`, with no field-level error.
- The register page (apps/console + app-shell console) has no legal links. `LoginPage.tsx:90-99` reads `features.termsUrl` / `privacyUrl`.

## Expected
The mismatch is an inline error on the confirm field. The register page shows the same 隐私 / 条款 links as login, ideally as 「创建账户即表示同意《条款》和《隐私政策》」 under the button.

## Dedupe
`gh api search/issues`, repos cloud / objectui / objectstack, incl. closed:
- `register page terms privacy`: 1 / 0 / 5, unrelated (connector listing, guest-model ADR, QA runs).
- `password mismatch`: 13 / 8 / 67. objectui#12600 (closed) reworked the login page only. No card on the register page's banner or legal links.
